evidence: Heavily alters wallet transaction construction, coin selection, fee-bumping, and wallet storage schemas to support sending to BIP 352 addresses.
rationale: Adds BIP 352 Silent Payment sending capability to the wallet, delivering a major privacy-enhancing feature for transaction creation. As noted in the description, it introduces dynamic taproot derivation, derivation-eligible coin selection, and recipient destination persistence to support RBF fee-bumping.
